# biznetgio_object_storage_object (Resource)

Thin convenience wrapper to upload/delete a single object via the BiznetGIO control-plane API. Tidak cocok untuk object besar — untuk scale, pakai tooling S3-compatible langsung dengan credential dari resource credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Convenience wrapper for small files via the control-plane API.
# Untuk object besar / throughput tinggi, pakai tooling S3-compatible
# langsung dengan credential dari biznetgio_object_storage_credential.
resource "biznetgio_object_storage_object" "example" {
  account_id = biznetgio_object_storage.example.id
  bucket     = biznetgio_object_storage_bucket.example.name
  key        = "config/app.yaml"
  source     = "${path.module}/app.yaml"
  acl        = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Object Storage instance account id.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `key` (String) Object key inside the bucket.

### Optional

- `acl` (String) S3-style canned ACL applied to the object.
- `content` (String, Sensitive) Inline content yang mau di-upload. Exactly one of `source`/`content` required.
- `source` (String) Path ke file lokal yang mau di-upload. Exactly one of `source`/`content` required.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id `<account_id>:<bucket>:<key>`.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON of the last read from the API, for anything not modeled yet.
